response.overview: Toward the end of the Pacific War, Japan dispatches special task force commander Oyama to Korea to hunt down the Mugunghwa-dan, a secret society of young activists fighting for Korean independence. The group's leader, Jeong Dong-min, was Oyama's college classmate during their student days in Tokyo, where the two competed for top honors and were romantic rivals for the affection of Dong-min's wife, Hye-yeong. Dong-min, Hye-yeong, and Oyama cross paths at a party; upon returning home, Hye-yeong is shocked to learn that her husband is the head of the Mugunghwa-dan. After safely boarding all of the organization's members onto a ship bound for Shanghai, Dong-min turns back, only to be cut down by Oyama's forces. Overwhelmed with grief, Hye-yeong cradles Dong-min in her arms and disappears, praying for the day of Korea's liberation.
